description: Final convergence review (#2016). Answers whether the goal and requirements are met, not whether every task is closed. Requirements are therefore a required input and tasks are only supporting evidence.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: The goal under judgment. Required: without it this Flow would degenerate into a task-completion review.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: Task records. Optional: absence degrades the coverage cross-check.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Test evidence. Optional: absence degrades the completion judgment.

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.description: Previous run record. Optional: absence skips the regression comparison.

steps.description: Missing `requirements` or `diff` stops here (both required inputs).
Requirements against the cumulative diff and the task records. Without task records it degrades to a requirements-versus-diff check.
Without test evidence this runs in a reduced form and records the degradation.
